address: Paseo de las Cobijadas 1, Vejer de la Frontera, 11150, Spain
bio: An intimate and unique restaurant, it takes its name from the nearby walls of Vejer, a beautiful ‘white village’ that was declared a Historic-Artistic Site in 1976. Chef Paco Doncel, from Vejer, after working in major restaurants, returned to his homeland to lead his own project in a place with a regional feel and casual atmosphere. Recommendations? We really liked his Judías pochas con almejas (beans with clams) and, off the menu, the Tortilla de tagarninas locales (local Spanish oyster thistle omelette). Given the seating capacity... we advise you to book!...
